summary: HIVE Digital Technologies filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary BUZZ High Performance Computing signed a five-year GPU cloud services agreement with an investment-grade customer. The contract covers a 2,016-GPU NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra cluster at a Merritt, British Columbia facility, with an estimated total value of $350 million and expected capex of $185 million. Deployment is targeted for Q4 2026; the customer provided a roughly 10% deposit. This is a routine commercial agreement, not a special-situation transaction, so it does not qualify as a merger, tender, or restructuring event.
